title: [spec-gap][R-LOADNG-018] B2.5 expanding-ring interop divergence: python receivers drop ring-2/3 RREQs (hop_limit>4)
description:
Spec B2.5: expanding-ring attempts at hop limits 4, 8, 15, each waiting RREQ_WAIT_TIME. Classification: divergent (cross-stack).

Evidence: python process_rreq handler-rejects any RREQ with hop_limit > INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT=4 before any state change (python/src/lichen/loadng/discovery.py:33-39,149-156; rationale bead project-LICHEN-worker6-0tk2: reverse-route cost INITIAL-hop_limit goes negative for rings 5..15), so a ring-2 (8) or ring-3 (15) flood is dropped at the first receiver and can never propagate beyond 4 hops — expanding ring beyond ring 1 is dead on arrival in python. C accepts and forwards them (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/loadng.c:685-689 forwards while hop_limit>1; cost math differs: MAX_HOP_LIMIT-hop_limit loadng.c:661). Rust codec accepts hop<=15 (rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs:398-413) but has no RREQ receive path at all. Vectors accept hop values up to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (test/vectors/loadng_messages.json rreq_max_hop_limit), so the wire format is fine — the divergence is receiver policy.

Suggested placement: either add traversed-hop data to the RREQ wire format (spec change) or switch cost derivation to ring index; pick one receiver policy across all three stacks; update spec B2.5/05-routing 10.3 to record chosen semantics.
close_reason: Converged all-stack RREQ receiver policy to the C reference: receivers accept any wire-legal expanding-ring RREQ (0..MAX_HOP_LIMIT=15, B2.5 rings 4/8/15); reverse-route cost = MAX_HOP_LIMIT - hop_limit (monotonic in traversed hops within a ring). Changes: (1) python discovery.py — handler guard now 0..MAX_HOP_LIMIT (crash guard from 0tk2 preserved for out-of-range), cost formula switched from INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT-hop_limit to MAX_HOP_LIMIT-hop_limit, docstrings/comments aligned; (2) spec 05-routing 10.3 + appendix B2.5 amended with the chosen semantics (MUST accept all rings; cross-ring cost not comparable); (3) test/vectors/generate.py: 9 vector expectations updated to 15-hl, 2 new ring-2/ring-3 receiver vectors added (24 total), loadng_discovery.json regenerated; (4) python tests rewritten for acceptance policy incl. out-of-range repeatability; (5) resolution note added to docs/spec-coverage/appendix-loadng-flagged.md R-LOADNG-018. Reviewer (kimi-k3) 3 passes: correctness PASS (1 P4 stale-comment finding, fixed inline), security no P0-P2 (2 findings fixed inline: comment + ring vectors), edge PASS. C-side hop_limit>15 validation gap remains tracked in 8ahs (commented with reviewer evidence); Rust receive path remains b7z9.197. Verification: python tests/loadng 206 passed, test_vectors loadng consumers 25 passed, full vector suite 969 passed (32 dao_origin_signature failures pre-exist on stashed baseline, tracked by open DAO beads); ruff clean; C/Rust untouched.
